**Continued 2.4.1**, a community-maintained fork of the Continue VS Code extension. Continued is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by Continue Dev, Inc.

It installs alongside the original extension (its ID is `b1tninja.continued`), keeps reading your existing `~/.continue` configuration, and collects no telemetry. To update from 2.4.0 or 2.2.0, install the new `.vsix` the same way; your settings are kept.

## Install

1. Download the `.vsix` for your platform below and, optionally, check it against `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
2. Run `code --install-extension continued-<platform>-2.4.1.vsix --force`, or in VS Code use the Extensions view: `...` → **Install from VSIX…**, then reload the window.

Requires VS Code 1.105 or newer. The packages are not code-signed. Full instructions: [install guide](https://github.com/b1tninja/continuous/blob/main/docs/continued-install.md).

| Platform                    | File                                                                   |
| --------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Windows x64 / Arm64         | `continued-win32-x64-2.4.1.vsix`, `continued-win32-arm64-2.4.1.vsix`   |
| macOS Apple Silicon / Intel | `continued-darwin-arm64-2.4.1.vsix`, `continued-darwin-x64-2.4.1.vsix` |
| Linux x64 / Arm64           | `continued-linux-x64-2.4.1.vsix`, `continued-linux-arm64-2.4.1.vsix`   |

Each platform also has an **agents** build, `continued-<platform>-2.4.1-agents.vsix`. It adds Continued to VS Code's Agents window through APIs that are still proposed, so it works in VS Code Insiders, or in Stable started with `code --enable-proposed-api b1tninja.continued`. Without that it works like the normal build. See [VS Code Chat and Agents](https://b1tninja.github.io/continuous/customize/vscode-chat-and-agents).

The Linux armhf and Alpine packages of 2.2.0 are gone: their native modules were built for other platforms and did not work.

## What's new since 2.4.0

**Providers and models**

- Switching to a variant with another reasoning effort (for example `#low` and `#high`, or Plan and Act) now warns again before losing the prompt cache: the effort can change the start of the prompt, as on Strata unless its model config sets `"effort_position": "end"`. Variants that only change sampling still switch without a warning.
- When a request fails after its retries, **Change model** opens the model picker, so the conversation can continue on another model.

**Amazon Bedrock**

- Tab autocomplete with Qwen models on Bedrock shows completions: they now get the same fill-in prompt as the other Bedrock models, instead of answering in a Markdown block the editor discarded.
- Tab completions on Bedrock are no longer cut after their first lines: the per-request time limit is 2 seconds instead of 1.

**Other**

- Importing MCP servers from Cline or Roo Code finds their settings files on every platform.

The full list of what 2.4 brought (the model catalog, variants, routes, retries, subagents, plan files and more) is in the [2.4.0 release notes](https://github.com/b1tninja/continuous/releases/tag/v2.4.0-vscode).

## Not included

The upstream CLI (`cn`), the JetBrains plugin and the hosted Continue Hub are not part of Continued. Hub `uses: owner/name` blocks are not supported; configure models and blocks directly or with local file paths.
